description: The constellation of standalone-equal peer roadmaps and companion artifacts in the bettyguo author profile. Each entry is a separate canonical repository that this roadmap points to sideways — not subordinated, not nested. All four together form the AI-engineer canonical set.

peers.title: Harness Engineer Roadmap
peers.blurb: The depth roadmap for the Agents & Harnesses stage of this roadmap. Where this repo treats agents and harnesses as one summarized stage of the AI-engineer career path, that repo dives all the way down on the harness-engineering craft.
peers.openWhen: You want to specialize in building agent harnesses / scaffolds.

peers.title: LLM Interview Prep
peers.blurb: Interview preparation tailored to AI engineer / LLM engineer / ML engineer roles. Concepts, system-design prompts, behavioral patterns, calibration on what 2026 interviews actually ask.
peers.openWhen: You are about to interview for an AI engineer role.

peers.title: Build Your Own AI
peers.blurb: A hands-on 'build it yourself' companion. Implement a transformer from scratch, a RAG pipeline from scratch, an agent harness from scratch — small, self-contained projects that lock the concepts in.
